Admission and eligibility

Applicants must meet minimum university entry standards set by the Commission for University Education (CUE). Specific program requirements vary and may include subject prerequisites or professional experience. Application Deadlines Undergraduate Programs: Applications open in January and close in August. Postgraduate Programs: Rolling admissions with priority deadlines in March and September. Scholarships & Financial Aid MUA offers merit-based and need-based scholarships to outstanding students. Financial aid packages and flexible payment plans are also available to ensure accessibility for all qualified applicants.
